summary: RptMnuInvoicing is a user control in the HSPnet system which is responsible for generating invoicing reports. It includes functionalities for managing filters, selecting agencies, departments, programs, terms, and other criteria for creating reports.
purpose: To facilitate the generation of invoicing reports within the HSPnet system by allowing users to select various filters and criteria.

workflows.name: Generate Invoicing Report
steps: Load previous filter values if available.
Fill dropdowns with data based on selected criteria.
Select items previously saved in filters.
Execute report generation logic based on user selections and filters.

workflows.name: Save Report Filters
steps: Update saved filters in UserReportFilters with current settings.

business_rules: In receiving mode, RA dropdown only contains the user's agency.
Department dropdown contains ALL in receiving mode.
Program dropdown contains ALL in receiving mode.
Site list must not be blank.
Report cannot be generated if no courses are selected in 'term mode'.
validations: Check if start date is provided.
Check if end date is provided.
conditions: If termMode is true, use term-related filters.
Select previously saved items using savedFilters dictionary.
Handle 'IncludeOption' with values 0, 1, 2 for different request types.
system_behavior: Display filters and dropdowns based on mode (receiving or placing).
Enable or disable controls based on selections.
Move selected items to the included list using JavaScript.
exceptions: Max courses selection exception based on PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
No report generated if criteria are not fulfilled.
